Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on tape, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?
A: It was on a multi-lane road in Pasadena, Texas, close to a shopping center. I was moving over one lane to get to a
turn.
Q: What were you doing right before the contact?
A: I checked my mirror, saw what I thought was clear space, and signaled. As I started to move over, I felt a bump on
my side and heard scraping metal.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?
A: Not really. It came up on my blind spot. I didn't see it until the sound happened.
Q: How fast were you traveling?
A: Maybe the speed of traffic, somewhere around the posted limit. Traffic was moving steadily.
Q: Did you stop after the collision?
A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder and turned on my hazards.
Q: Were you injured?
A: I hit my head on the window frame. I've been diagnosed with a concussion. I've had headaches, sensitivity to light,
and I'm having trouble concentrating at work.
Q: Are you currently receiving treatment?
A: Yes, I'm seeing a doctor and I've been told to limit screen time and rest as much as possible.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I want my vehicle repaired and my medical bills taken care of. I'm willing to provide my medical records.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
